content: The API has no authentication, so it binds to 127.0.0.1 and uses an explicit CORS allow-list, never allow_origins=['*'].

description: re.IGNORECASE applied to a whole pattern defeated an explicit [A-Z] character class. The 'does this headline lead with another company's ticker' guard was ^([A-Z]{1,5})\s+(stock|shares) with IGNORECASE for the keyword, so 'Space stocks are falling hard' and 'Tesla shares rise' matched as other companies' tickers and were silently discarded.
resolution: Drop the flag and spell the alternatives out ([Ss]tock). Rule: IGNORECASE and a case-based character class must never share a pattern. Caught only by a test asserting that a sector headline SURVIVES; all the rejection tests passed. Any filter whose failure mode is discarding input needs a test that good input gets through.

name: Backfill on follow, off the request path
description: Following a stock returns 201 immediately and runs the month-long price and news backfill in a FastAPI BackgroundTask (jobs.backfill_stock), guarded by a per-symbol lock so a double-add cannot fan out two identical month-long scrapes. jobs.catch_up() runs on API start to finish any backfill interrupted by a restart, tracked by watchlist.backfilled_at. Quotes are served from the DB: a symbol with no price yet is fetched inline so the UI never shows blanks, while a merely stale one is served immediately and refreshed in the background. Keeps reads fast while the feed fills in within seconds of adding a stock.
